name: fee-basis-official-excess-reimbursement

Form 2106, Fee-basis county magistrate, capacity FeeBasisOfficial, employer Example County Court: local transportation $100.00, travel $0.00, other $250.00 (court-rule publications), meals $0.00, no other reimbursement. One owned standard-mileage vehicle: 0 miles January-June, 2,000 business miles July-December, 11,000 miles in all, 2,400 commuting miles, parking and tolls $30.00. Line 22 = 2,000 x 76 cents = $1,520.00, so line 1 = $1,520.00. Line 2 = 100.00 + 30.00 = $130.00. Line 4 = $250.00. Line 6 column A = 1,520 + 130 + 0 + 250 = $1,900.00; column B = $0.00. Line 7 = code L $2,000.00 + $0.00 = $2,000.00; worksheet ratio = 0 / 1,900 = 0.000, so 7B = $0.00 and 7A = $2,000.00. Line 8A = max(1,900 - 2,000, 0) = $0.00 and the column A excess is $100.00, wage income on Form 1040 line 1a; 8B = $0.00. Line 10 = $0.00, so Schedule 1 line 12 = $0.00. Form 1040 line 1a = 52,000 + 30,000 + 100 = $82,100.00; line 9 = $82,100.00; line 11a/11b = $82,100.00; line 12e (married filing jointly, Rev. Proc. 2025-32 Table 8) = $32,200.00; line 15 = $49,900.00; line 16: the 2026 draft Tax Table row 49900-49950, joint column = $5,495.00 (10% of $24,800 = $2,480.00 plus 12% of ($49,925 midpoint - $24,800) = $3,015.00). Line 24a = $5,495.00. Line 25a = $6,000.00 + $3,000.00 = $9,000.00; line 33 = $9,000.00; line 34 = $3,505.00.
